houses.label: No. 15 / Gambrel family cottage

source.type: Published pattern-book design; no as-built survey

sourceDimensions.qualifier: Printed 26 x 33 ft conflicts with the sum of room widths in the plan; native composition follows the room arrangement.

notes: Gambrel roof, central porch and front upper chamber distinguish this house.
The source living room has a grille dividing its dining end; that transition is kept as an open framed span.
Printed 26 ft width and individual room widths disagree; the 10 m composition follows the illustrated arrangement, not a claimed measured reproduction.

Roof correction: continuous steep skirts and shallow crowns replace the notched footprint roof. Extended eaves clear the two full native wall courses. Roof angles, overhangs and the lower front ridge are artistic adaptations, not source measurements.
Per user art direction, vertical gable faces carry horizontal clapboard; cedar shingles remain on the sloped roof surfaces.
The centered two-space window is deferred to the map-editor work requested separately by the user. Existing window openings are retained.
Historical floor heights and overall feet are recorded separately; native wall and door geometry is never rescaled.

roofAssembly.junction: Exact planar valley cuts remove roof faces buried inside the intersecting gambrel. Front rear-end cap omitted below main roof.
